sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(client_identifier) FROM clients WHERE borrowing_cap <= 100000 AND client_identifier IN (SELECT client_identifier FROM remittances WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', remittance_moment) = '2004')), T1.client_label FROM clients AS T1 INNER JOIN remittances AS T2 ON T1.client_identifier = T2.client_identifier WHERE T1.borrowing_cap <= 100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.remittance_moment) = '2004' GROUP BY T1.client_identifier, T1.client_label ORDER BY SUM(T2.total_value) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(t1.purchase_identifier) FROM purchase_lines AS t1 INNER JOIN merchandise AS t2 ON t1.item_identifier = t2.item_identifier WHERE t2.suggested_retail - t2.acquisition_cost > 100
SELECT SUM(t1.total_value) FROM remittances AS t1 INNER JOIN clients AS t2 ON t1.client_identifier = t2.client_identifier WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t1.remittance_moment) = '2003' AND t2.borrowing_cap = 0

SELECT COUNT(t1.staff_identifier), t1.network_address FROM staff AS t1 INNER JOIN branches AS t2 ON t1.branch_identifier = t2.branch_identifier WHERE t2.municipality = 'Sydney' AND t1.role_designation LIKE '%Sales Manager%'

SELECT t2.item_label, t1.requested_count * t1.unit_cost FROM purchase_lines AS t1 INNER JOIN merchandise AS t2 ON t1.item_identifier = t2.item_identifier INNER JOIN purchases AS t3 ON t1.purchase_identifier = t3.purchase_identifier INNER JOIN clients AS t4 ON t3.client_identifier = t4.client_identifier INNER JOIN staff AS t5 ON t4.commerce_agent_staff_identifier = t5.staff_identifier INNER JOIN branches AS t6 ON t5.branch_identifier = t6.branch_identifier WHERE t6.municipality = 'Boston' AND t5.role_designation = 'Sales Rep' ORDER BY t1.requested_count * t1.unit_cost DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT dial_number FROM clients WHERE liaison_family_surname LIKE 'M%' AND nation <> 'Germany'
SELECT AVG(total_value) FROM remittances WHERE remittance_moment >= '2004-01-01' AND remittance_moment < '2004-07-01'

SELECT (t1.suggested_retail - t2.unit_cost) / t1.suggested_retail FROM merchandise AS t1 INNER JOIN purchase_lines AS t2 ON t1.item_identifier = t2.item_identifier WHERE t2.item_identifier = 'S18_3482' AND t2.purchase_identifier = 10108
